text: HARD BLOCKER for this epic, filed as bd-01KZXQAW39E8XCXJJVW7C7M2M6. plan_geometry() fails at p=50000 - your own gate fixture size - with an 18.6 GiB sparse-to-dense coercion, which is exactly p^2 doubles. Cause traced to .additive_frame_signature (R/measurement.R:490), which calls as.matrix() on the sparse frame purely to hash it. Called once in plan_geometry and three times in evaluate_geometry, plus inside .compose_frame_metric. This is on the IDENTITY-metric feature-additive fast path, so the dense-metric path is strictly worse. The 4 GiB / 30 min gate cannot currently be met or even measured. Fix is to hash the sparse triplet (@i, @p, @x, @Dim) - 1657x smaller at 50k and a better signature. Also measured: wall time on this path is ~p^1.8 (3.4/6.4/13.6/48.0s at p=1000/2197/4096/8000), extrapolating to ~19 min at 50k for q=4 only.
